concepts.definition: the systematic collection and analysis of information about customers, competitors, and market conditions
the division of a broad market into smaller groups with similar needs, characteristics, or behaviours
the specific group of customers a business chooses to serve with its marketing activities
a good, service, or idea offered to satisfy a customer need or want
the amount of money or other value a customer gives in exchange for a product
the channels and activities used to make a product available to target customers
communication activities used to inform, persuade, or remind customers about an offering
the creation and management of a distinctive identity that differentiates an offering from competitors
the study of how individuals or groups select, buy, use, and evaluate products
the process of exchanging a product for payment and managing the customer interaction that supports the transaction
